output.title: ACME profiles extension feature added in cert-manager
output.content: This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate CRD installed, indicating active ACME certificate management. The v1.18.0 upgrade adds support for ACME profiles extension (draft-aaron-acme-profiles), an optional ACME specification enhancement. The feature will not affect you unless you configure ACME issuers to use profiles extension, which is not evident from the current configuration. Review whether your ClusterIssuers or Issuers attempt to use ACME profiles and whether this feature enables new functionality you need.
